items.title: Flat base change of immersions: the comparison map of higher conormal algebras is onto and an isomorphism when flat
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: In a cartesian square of algebraic spaces with immersions i : Z -> X and i' : Z' -> X', the canonical map f^* C_{Z'/X',*} -> C_{Z/X,*} of graded conormal algebras is surjective, and an isomorphism when g : X -> X' is flat. The retained proof states its reduction explicitly: the assertion can be checked after etale localization on X', which brings the square to a morphism of schemes where all four terms are schemes' conormal algebras, and the schemes case from the Divisors chapter then gives both the surjectivity and the flat isomorphism. Retained author proof at lines 786-792.
